title: GURSIMRAT GILL VS. STATE OF PUNJAB

paras.text:
ITEM NO.34 COURT NO.3 SECTION II-B
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS
Petition(s) for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No(s). 16298/2026
[Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 07-08-2026
in CRWP No. 7157/2026 passed by the High Court of Punjab & Haryana
at Chandigarh]
GURSIMRAT GILL Petitioner(s)
 VERSUS
STATE OF PUNJAB & ORS. Respondent(s)
Date : 14-10-2026 This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.M. SUNDRESH
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRASANNA B. VARALE
For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Satwant Singh Rangi, Sr. Adv.
 Ms. Herinder Kaur Brar- 2464, AOR
Ms. Aneet Kaur, Adv.
Mr. Devesh Mishra, Adv.
Mr. Nitish Kumar, Adv.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Siddhant Sharma- 3228, AOR
 Mr. Snehil Himanshu, Adv.
Mr. Harshit Khanduja, AOR
Mr. Vasu Pandit, Adv.

Upon hearing the counsel, the Court made the following
 O R D E R
1. As a final chance, a period of two weeks is granted
to the learned counsel for the respondent(s) for filing
the counter affidavit.
2. In the meantime, the respondent(s) shall ensure that
the child is able to interact with the petitioner for a
period of one hour every day on video call.
3. List the matter on 29.10.2026.
 (SHUBHAM SONI) (POONAM VAID)
COURT MASTER (SH) ASSISTANT REGISTRAR
